bets.event: HANJIN BRION vs Kiwoom DRX — Game 3
bets.format: Best-of-three series; deciding Game 3 with the series tied 1-1
bets.result: Kiwoom DRX won Game 3; HANJIN BRION moneyline lost. Exact final map score was not supplied.
bets.entryState: At 2:38, kills were 0-0, gold was effectively even and no towers or major objectives had been taken.

KRX: confirmed starting five with Aiming replacing LazyFeel

bets.teamStrengthPrior: BRO was rated stronger overall in player quality, coordination and conversion.

modelRecommendation.reasoning: BRO retained the stronger team-strength prior and the live price reached the trigger while KRX had gained no early structural advantage.

execution.priceMoveClassification: minor adverse price move with the same early-game state
execution.attributionTier: model-compliant official execution with price slippage
deviations: accepted odds were 1.943 rather than the quoted 2.000

review.resultAssessment: KRX won the deciding map. By 28:44, KRX led 8-4 in kills, 52.8k-48.2k in gold and 3-1 in towers, demonstrating sustained control before the close.
review.processAssessment: The model overweighted BRO's generic team-strength prior and underweighted KRX's composition-specific macro advantage. Nocturne-Shen globals, Ryze map movement and Sivir wave control created a coordinated objective and tempo system that KRX executed cleanly.
review.calibrationAction: Before backing the nominally stronger team in a deciding map, score global pressure, side-lane response, objective setup and observed series macro separately. A neutral 0-0 early state is not sufficient confirmation when the opponent has a superior coordinated map-control composition.

bets.notes: User confirmed KRX won Game 3 and described KRX's macro and control as clean. BRO moneyline at 1.943 for 0.25u (125,000 VND), slip #1148615228, lost. Return 0 VND and net loss 125,000 VND (-0.25u).
